claims.text: [R54, malformed field types] validate_ruleset now checks that each rule's id, pattern, direction and category is a non-empty string before any set lookup or compile. It also sorts unknown keys by repr. A list, mapping, number, bool or null in any field is therefore a RulesetError naming the rule and field, not a TypeError. When the packaged table is damaged, cma run refuses with exit 2; before the fix it reported a model failure with exit 4. Tests: test_a_rule_field_of_the_wrong_type_is_refused (20 cases), test_a_table_field_of_the_wrong_type_is_refused, test_a_damaged_packaged_table_is_refused_on_load, and test_cma_run_refuses_a_damaged_table_rather_than_blaming_the_model (list category, list id, mapping direction). The reviewer's repro was also run on a disposable copy of the package.
